objective: Decide whether the unchanged ten-donor portfolio qualifies as the second distinct stable post-donor release after real agentkit workflow observation.

environment.runtime: python-3 fixture, repository and marketplace validators

datasets: ten unchanged donor routing and behavior suites
three real agentkit semantic workflow observations
repository, dependency, registry, package and marketplace validators

criteria.structure: official and repository validators pass for all unchanged donors
criteria.routing: donor suites and agentkit explicit routing boundaries pass
criteria.behavior: prior hash-bound evidence plus three real semantic workflows pass
criteria.authority: no donor, activation, installation or external authority changes occur
criteria.documentation: documentation containment and E2E evidence locators validate
criteria.coexistence: all 38 released packages remain collision-free while agentkit stays candidate-only
criteria.lifecycle: release, registry, dependency, generated package and maturity views agree

holdout_policy.exposure_rule: outside distributed candidate; rotate after material behavior change

execution_policy.cleanup: remove only evaluator-created build staging after evidence capture
